effect_description_eng: [Opponent's Turn] When an opponent's Digimon is played or digivolves, if that Digimon is level 5 or higher, you may digivolve this Digimon into a [Infermon] from your hand without paying the cost, ignoring digivolution requirements.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [On Deletion] If this Digimon had [Unidentified] trait, you may play 1 [Diaboromon] Token without paying the cost. (Digimon/Cost 14/Lv.6/White/Mega/Unknown/Unidentified/3000 DP)
